description: Maintained C++ ownership and compiler-boundary evidence supplementing the historical disassembler claims in function_ownership.json. Exact-byte acceptance is the full make verify build; these records alone do not establish a fresh match.

groups.abi: Complete MSVC 7.1 string methods with the thiscall object in ECX; LegacyString_Clear is fastcall with the same ECX pointer.
ownership_evidence: Storage layout: allocator cookie at +0, 16-byte union at +4, length at +0x14, capacity at +0x18.
Historical Reserve at 0x00438380 is ResetInlineStorage(release_heap, new_length), a void operation, not capacity reservation.
Assign owns the complete 37-byte compiler section, including 3 bytes of compiler-emitted alignment at 0x0043835D. Disassembler body-range claims remain unchanged.
The original range error, length error and Grow remain separately bound assembly dependencies.

groups.abi: NextWord is thiscall; the five free functions are fastcall. The state pointer occupies ECX in every recovered entry.
ownership_evidence: The 39-byte entry at 0x0044B9B0 is one complete seed/generation update, shared by the recovered RNG family.
0x0044BA30 is a separate complete entry with identical NextU32 behavior. Alternate is a descriptive recovered name; the original API name is unknown.
The local 16-bit subtraction result preserves the recurrence width; the four-word buffer in DoubleStep accounts for the original stack-cookie code.

groups.abi: Four-argument Win32 stdcall dialog procedure; return value occupies EAX.
ownership_evidence: Controls 201 and 203 select dialog results 6 and 7; control 202 stores configuration bit 0x100.
Win32 references are imported function-pointer slots; g_startup_config_flags binds the original 32-bit configuration word.

groups.abi: Five-argument WinMM stdcall callback; the third argument is a target pointer whose slot-zero virtual method receives ECX.
ownership_evidence: The vtable at 0x0046F80C supplies the MIDI tick entry at 0x0043AF30.
Only the callback is recovered here; the custom-EDI sequencer reset remains assembly.

groups.abi: Native MSVC LTCG internal ABI: this in ESI; Decrement receives count in EAX, Advance receives a stack float and removes four bytes.
ownership_evidence: Each method is selected as its entire named CODE contribution from a fresh native compiler/linker image at its final retail address.
The synthetic array caller is compiler context, not recovered game code or evidence of the original translation unit.
Layout gap arrays and the compiler-context function are never selected into the final executable or counted as C++ recovery.
